field.name: provider
field.label: Cloud LLM Provider
field.description: OpenRouter is recommended. NVIDIA NIM is used automatically as fallback.

field.name: api_endpoint
field.label: API Endpoint (optional)
field.description: Leave blank to use the provider preset endpoint.

field.name: model
field.label: Model (optional)
field.description: Leave blank to use the provider preset model.

field.name: api_key_file
field.label: API Key File
field.description: Root-only file containing the provider API key. Never paste keys into the GUI or config.xml.

field.name: send_context
field.label: Send firewall context
field.description: Include a small, non-sensitive snapshot (rule counts, interface names, gateway IPs) with requests. Disable to keep all firewall metadata local.

field.name: system_prompt
field.label: System Prompt
field.description: Instructions for the AI assistant behavior and knowledge
